Psychology and consumer behaviour

text: Miller (2010) proposed impulse control therapy which he developed from his feeling‑state theory
of impulse control disorders. This therapy uses what Miller calls the impulse control disorder
protocol (ICDP), a procedure which uses a modified form of eye movement desensitisation and
reprocessing (EMDR).

Psychology and health

text: The success of the disrupt‑then‑reframe (DTR) technique (Kardes et al., 2007)
Experiment 1 shows that the DTR technique increases retail sales in a supermarket setting.
Experiment 2 shows that the DTR technique increases the willingness to pay to join a student
interest group.
Experiment 3 shows that the DTR technique increases student support for a tuition fee increase.
